svg.title: ESO's sites in Chile, and Paranal with the four Unit Telescopes
svg.desc: Left: Chile with ESO's sites at Paranal, Cerro Armazones, where the ELT is being built, and La Silla. Right: a rendered model of the Paranal summit seen from the west, with the four Unit Telescopes, VST, the VLTI laboratory, the Auxiliary Telescope stations and tracks and the control building; UT2 open for the night, and the light ducts under the platform from each Unit Telescope to the Combined-Coudé Laboratory. Inset: UT2 with its enclosure removed, showing the telescope on its fork and the path of the light from the primary mirror to the secondary, to the Nasmyth B focus and down to the Coudé room.
